## Checklist

- [ ] `make verify` passes (fmt, lint, build, unit tests)
- [ ] Acceptance tests added/updated for behavior changes (`make testacc` against a TEST site)
- [ ] Docs regenerated with `make docs` if schemas changed (edit `templates/`, never `docs/` directly)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under the unreleased version
- [ ] Conventional Commit message (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
